legacy_baseline.initial_import_error_reason: retired controller globals removed from main; not new Core behavior failures

status_definitions.covered: Concrete current Core service, PG, HTTP or pure resource regression covers the behavior within scope_and_change; refs are not results and require the full suite to pass.
status_definitions.intentional_change: Old internal API or product scope was deliberately replaced; replacement regression listed and difference explicit. Not claimed unchanged compatibility.

verification.method: AST enumerates the exact original 102 IDs; every current test reference is checked against actual defined methods. Genuine service scenarios replace old state fakes.
verification.suite_command: CHART_PYTHON=<isolated calculator python> python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_core*.py -v
verification.live_model_comparison: tools/compare_core_providers.py; separate evidence, no claim fixture replay measures real model quality
